title: Credit balance is too low
body:

top_comments.author: ghost
top_comments.body:
Hi! Is it possible you are authenticated with a different organization than the one the funds were added to? Please try running 

```
$ claude /logout
$ claude
```

and then signing in again with your account

top_comments.author: searayca
top_comments.body:
I was correctly logged in. I did end up logging out and logging back in,
and it fixed the problem. This was last ditch effort before I heard back
from you. Very aggravating.

Greg


On Fri, Apr 25, 2025 at 10:40 AM levpopov ***@***.***> wrote:

> *levpopov* left a comment (anthropics/claude-code#867)

>
> Hi! Is it possible you are authenticated with a different organization
> than the one the funds were

top_comments.author: alittlesliceoftom
top_comments.body:
I had this problem too, which was resolved by running `/login`. 

The error message could be a little clearer, i.e. indicate the currently logged in account, and suggest the /login command. 

I think that perhaps I had previously logged in before authentication via plan was available.
